en: A black‑and‑white vintage view of a railway station with a wooden two‑storey building and platform in the foreground. Several sets of train tracks run across the image, with a low freight wagon and a railway worker standing near luggage or cargo on the platform. Behind the station are residential buildings with steep roofs. At the top of the image, printed text identifies the location.
